candidates: When finding the maximum value in an array, use `Math.max(...array)` rather than sorting the array and popping the last element — the former is more readable and idiomatic.
Use template literal syntax for string interpolation (e.g., `\`${key} [${data[key]}]\``) rather than string concatenation.

Diagram renderers should access diagram-specific configuration exclusively through `diagObj.db` accessor methods (e.g., `diagObj.db.getShowData()`). Renderers must not read configuration directly from `conf` or `globalConfig` objects.

When combining optional boolean/numeric config flags from multiple sources, use the nullish coalescing operator `??` instead of `||` so that intentional `false` or `0` values are not silently overridden.

Reusable rendering helpers (such as text-width measurement) belong in `packages/mermaid/src/rendering-util`, not inlined in individual diagram renderers. For text-width measurement specifically, use the existing SVG-based approach (see `createText.ts`) rather than a canvas element, so that the correct font family, size, and style context is applied.
When setting the `viewBox` attribute on an SVG element, use the native DOM API (`elem.setAttribute("viewBox", ...)`) rather than a d3 `.attr()` call.

Rendering changes that affect SVG output attributes (e.g., `viewBox`, `width`, `style`) must be accompanied by integration tests (e.g., in `cypress/integration/rendering/`) that assert the expected attribute values on the rendered SVG element.
